title: Municipal Dashboard
description: Administrative platform centralizing 24 municipal management modules behind a single sign-on.
highlights: SSO authentication with Keycloak
Server state with TanStack Query and Docker deployment
Dark mode with semantic tokens and theme-aware Recharts charts

title: Municipal Fines Payments
description: Payment system for citizens: look up the infraction, pay it and download an official receipt.
highlights: Payment by MercadoPago QR and by card through Banco Galicia NAVE
Receipt styled as an Argentine fiscal document, PDF generated with Gotenberg
Receipt persisted in the backend so it can be recovered after the payment processor redirect

title: Traffic Court Portal
description: Citizen-facing site with department-specific forms and case follow-up.
highlights: Forms for Traffic, Food Safety, General Inspection and Public Works
Submission and lookup of statements with image and video attachments
Custom Tailwind design tokens, styled after a municipal ledger

title: Digital Newspaper Archive
description: Digital archive of historical Catamarca newspapers, with a searchable library catalog.
highlights: PDF viewer with page-flip animation, optimized for mobile
Content in Directus CMS and catalog integrated with the Koha API
Catalog with pagination and modal detail views

title: Real-Time Voting System
description: Voting platform with instant results and geographic segmentation of participation.
highlights: WebSockets to update results without reloading
Participation dashboards by zone
60% operational efficiency gain after optimizing architecture and data flows

title: Revenue Collection System
description: Financial dashboard to track revenue collection and operational performance.
highlights: Advanced filters and date-range reports
Collection indicators and analysis charts

title: Personal Finance Dashboard
description: Analysis of my own spending recorded since 2023, with forecasting and recurring expense detection.
highlights: Projection tab with expense forecasting
Automatic recurring expense detector
Excel import
